answer: The bung maker turns his plugs on the lathe, and the plug must fit snug or the cask breathes out its wine. Chime oak stave bender elm bond is the turning: a bond oak stave benders lodge after bending frame checks. The walnut turns first in the morning, the quill turns last before the lathe stops, and the raven is the lathe itself, humming since dawn. A cheat must turn 43 false plugs and stop 43 false lathes.
